AboutUs.title: About Me
AboutUs.quote: Representation and defense of commercial interests in judicial disputes and arbitrations with the highest technical rigor.
AboutUs.body: With more than two decades of experience in the legal sector, I have specialized in designing complex strategies to protect the assets and reputation of national and international corporations. My approach combines academic sophistication with a pragmatic business vision, ensuring robust solutions both in commercial litigation and in highly complex arbitration tribunals.
AboutUs.credentialOne: Active member of the Spanish Bar Association
AboutUs.credentialTwo: Certified specialist in Commercial Law and Mergers
AboutUs.credentialThree: Certified arbitrator by the Commercial Arbitration Center
AboutUs.imageAlt: Attorney specialized in commercial law and arbitration

PracticeAreas.title: Practice Areas
PracticeAreas.description: Comprehensive legal solutions designed to protect your assets and accelerate your commercial projects.
PracticeAreas.corporateText: Company formation, corporate governance, and legal structuring of business projects.
PracticeAreas.civilText: Contracts of all kinds, asset claims, and defense of individual rights.
PracticeAreas.laborText: Hiring strategies, defense in labor litigation, and labor regulatory compliance.
PracticeAreas.commercialText: Mergers, acquisitions, commercial restructuring, and corporate transactions.
PracticeAreas.intellectualText: Trademark registration, patents, software protection, copyright, and trade secrets.
PracticeAreas.litigationText: Representation and defense of commercial interests in judicial disputes and arbitration.

FAQ.title: I answer your questions before we get started
FAQ.description: Didn't find the answer you were looking for? Write to me for personalized advice.
FAQ.questionOne: How do I schedule a first consultation?
FAQ.answerOne: You can schedule your consultation directly through the 'Schedule Consultation' button on our website, selecting the date and time that best suits your availability, or by sending me a direct message via WhatsApp.
FAQ.answerTwo: Our main office is located in a central corporate area. We serve clients in person by appointment and also offer services at executive locations upon request.
FAQ.questionThree: What areas of law do you practice?
FAQ.answerThree: We specialize in Corporate, Commercial, Civil, Labor, Intellectual Property, and Commercial Litigation and Arbitration law.
FAQ.answerFour: Yes, we offer 100% virtual consultation sessions via video call for national and international clients with the same effectiveness and technical rigor as an in-person consultation.
